summary.name: Kimi
summary.one_liner: Kimi is Moonshot AI's chat and agent assistant for coding projects, 3D modeling, financial research and other multi-step agentic tasks.
use_cases: build coding projects with an AI agent
run deep research on financial topics
summary.what_it_does: The page is a marketing landing page for Kimi, promoting the Kimi K3.1 Pro model for complex coding, 3D model building, financial research and agentic work. The chat interface lists modes and plugins including 3D Make, Slides, Deep Research, Docs, Build, Sheets and Design, plus Projects and Scheduled tasks. It offers a desktop app download and a mode selector for reasoning effort (High). The page does not describe technical details, benchmarks or how each tool works.
notable: Agent modes for 3D Make, Slides, Deep Research, Docs, Build, Sheets and Design
caveats: Page does not state pricing or whether features are free or paid
Login is required to sync chat history
Marketing-heavy page with few technical specifics
